comum.semPermissao: Your user is not allowed to use this module.

grafo.local: Not signed in: the graph only lives in this window.

lgpd.intro: You control your data. Each purpose can be turned on or off at any time.
lgpd.f.terms: Terms of use and privacy notice

lgpd.localTexto: Gusto OS preferences (language, window positions) stay only in this browser.
boas.p1: The bottom bar groups the modules; hover to see what each one does.

gdesc.cozinha: Order, prepare, deliver and track: the everyday Gusto app.

gdesc.comunidade: Talk with the community and ask the assistant.
gdesc.conta: Your data, privacy and system information.
base.inicio: Home panel with your shortcuts, today's schedule and panels.

base.agenda: Drag-and-drop calendar for preparations, deliveries and appointments.
base.carteira: Credits, balance in R$, credit market and payment links.
base.mapa: Proximity map with cooks, couriers and orders.
base.mais: More: recipe assistant, tutorials, spaces, welcome guide.
base.guardados: Panels you saved to the bar to open later.
base.avisos: Notifications about orders, payments and the system.
base.papel: Switch the active role: customer, cook, courier or inspector.
base.creditos: Your available credits in the wallet.
base.detalhe: Turns detailed mode on or off (more numbers and details).
base.acess: Contrast, text size, reduced motion and other options.
